feed.title: Verity Mod verified route updates
feed.subtitle: Point-in-time checks of current Minecraft Java and Bedrock Verity project records.

entry.title: API key source guidance added for 401 searches
entry.summary: Expanded the Verity Mod API connection failed guide after SERP and Search Console evidence showed 401, 429, and API-key confusion. The page now separates where Groq, OpenRouter, and Ollama credentials or local setup come from, warns against posting API keys in public comments or screenshots, and explains why a change from 401 to 429 means authentication may now work while the provider is rate limiting the account or organization.

entry.title: APK and Google Play app safety route added
entry.summary: Added a dedicated Verity Mod APK and Google Play app safety page after current SERP checks showed mobile app and APK-style results competing with MCPE and Bedrock add-on intent. The page explains that normal MCPE installation uses MCADDON or MCPACK packages, separates Google Play app claims from official Bedrock project records, and links users to Verity BE record 8506198, PnTMC record 8503821, Verity Pocket Edition (Be) record 8406293, MCPEDL route notes, and the browser-only source checker.

entry.title: Verity BE 1.1.0 current route refreshed
entry.summary: Checked July 26, 2026 after the official CurseForge Verity BE file changed to Verity (Stable) (1.1.0)-(26.3).mcaddon, record 8506198, 21.3 MB, for Bedrock 26.30. The same check refreshed visible project totals: Verity JE 2,107,588 CurseForge downloads and 237,507 Modrinth downloads, Verity BE 3,749,016 downloads, PnTMC 6,693,987 downloads, and Verity Pocket Edition (Be) 44,339 downloads. The browser checker, homepage, download guide, Bedrock guide, MCPE guide, link guide, creator reference, FAQ, and machine-readable JSON now point current Verity BE users to record 8506198 instead of the previous 8486588 record.
